summary: Audit of provided excerpts: one escalation violation (agent failed to offer escalation when customer complained). No violations in personal_data, verification, promises, or conduct.

findings.quote: Sorry. I have no way of getting to the package. It is in the hands of the delivery service and they are already en route.
findings.explanation: Customer expressed a complaint and asked whether anything could be done (turns 24-26). The agent did not acknowledge the complaint or offer an escalation route (supervisor, complaint form, or internal escalation), which is required by policy when a customer makes a complaint. This is a major violation (a complaint was ignored).
